findings.description: records() now runs every record through upgrade_record, which drops `user_id` and stores it as `account_id`. New records are written with `account_id` only. `record.get("user_id")` is therefore always None, so for_account never matches anything and account_timeline always returns an empty list.
findings.title: for_account filters on legacy `user_id` key that records() has already removed
